website.notes: Verified 2026-10-27 (drafter + reviewer fetches). 'Global AI product & deployment company'; principle: AI should be yours to control (see AI spend, choose models, switch providers). Products: Affinda Control (AI cost control, sits between a company and its AI providers), Affinda Extract (document automation, documents into structured data), Affinda Deployment (AI adoption/enablement plus applied AI engineering, prototype to production), Affinda Resume Parser, Draftable (legal doc comparison, 1,300+ legal teams). Founded 2012 by brothers Ben Toner (PhD quantum physics, Caltech) and Tim Toner (ex-Macquarie, Lazard), Melbourne. 120+ employees, 2,800+ customers, 85+ countries. ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 2.
